purpose: Identify external literature needed before treating the S2T mixed-trace integer 10 as a theorem.

examples: D. B. Ray and I. M. Singer, R-torsion and the Laplacian on Riemannian manifolds, 1971
D. B. Ray and I. M. Singer, Analytic torsion for complex manifolds, Annals of Mathematics 98 (1973)
source_clusters.relevance: Provides the classical determinant/Hodge/zeta framework for relating Laplacians on forms to torsion-like invariants.

examples: A. S. Schwarz, The partition function of degenerate quadratic functional and Ray-Singer invariants, 1978
A. S. Schwarz, The partition function for topological field theories / BF-type treatments
source_clusters.relevance: Connects degenerate gauge quadratic functionals, zero modes, gauge fixing, and determinant factors to Ray-Singer torsion.

source_clusters.cluster: Spectra of lens spaces on functions and p-forms
examples: A. Ikeda and Y. Yamamoto, On the spectra of 3-dimensional lens spaces
E. Lauret, R. J. Miatello, J. P. Rossetti, The spectrum on p-forms of a lens space
E. Lauret, R. J. Miatello, J. P. Rossetti, Spectra of lens spaces from 1-norm spectra of congruence lattices
source_clusters.relevance: Directly constrains scalar/exact/coexact multiplicity bookkeeping on RP^3=L(2,1).

examples: Faddeev-Popov method and BRST gauge fixing references
Hodge-decomposition treatments of abelian gauge partition functions on compact manifolds
source_clusters.relevance: Needed to verify the sign and exponent of the scalar ghost determinant and whether exact modes cancel or survive in the finite mixed trace.

current_internal_claim.candidate_origin: RP3 scalar/ghost even cumulative degeneracy d0+d2=1+9

literature_gate_verdict: The external literature supports the relevance of lens-space p-form spectra, Ray-Singer torsion, Hodge decomposition, and gauge/ghost determinant bookkeeping. It does not yet prove the S2T selection rule ell=0,2 nor the mixed-trace sign. Those remain explicit proof obligations.
